chapter.li: LEChapter5 Verse1 And now it came to pass that when king Benjamin had thus spoken to his people, he sent among them, desiring to know of his people if they believed the words which he had spoken unto them. VerseEnd Verse2 And they all cried with one voice, saying, Yea, we believe all the words which 2PSI thou hast spoken unto us! And also, we know of their surety and truth because of the spirit of the Lord Omnipotent, which has wrought a mighty change in us, or in our hearts, that we have no more disposition to do evil, but to do good continually. VerseEnd Verse3 And we, ourselves, also through the infinite goodness of God and the manifestations of his spirit, have great views of that which is to come; and were it expedient, we could prophesy of all things. VerseEnd Verse4 And it is the faith which we have had on the things which our king has spoken unto us that has brought us to this great knowledge, whereby we do rejoice with such exceeding great joy. VerseEnd Verse5 And we are willing to enter into a covenant with our God to do his will, and to be obedient to his commandments in all things that he shall command us, all the remainder of our days, that we may not bring upon ourselves a never-ending torment as has been spoken by the angel, that we may not drink out of the cup of the wrath of God. VerseEnd

Verse6 And now these are the words which king Benjamin desired of them, and therefore, he said unto them, 2PP Ye have spoken the words that I desired, and the covenant which 2PP ye have made is a righteous covenant. VerseEnd Verse7 And now, because of the covenant which 2PP ye have made, 2PP ye shall be called the children of Christ, his sons and his daughters; for behold, this day he hath spiritually begotten 2PP you. For 2PP ye say that 2PP your hearts are changed through faith on his name, therefore 2PP ye are born of him and have become his sons and his daughters. VerseEnd Verse8 And under this head 2PP ye are made free, and there is no other head whereby 2PP ye can be made free; there is no other name given whereby salvation cometh. Therefore I would that 2PP ye should take upon 2PP you the name of Christ, all 2PP you that have entered into the covenant with God that 2PP ye should be obedient unto the end of 2PP your lives. VerseEnd Verse9 And it shall come to pass that whosoever doeth this shall be found at the right hand of God, for he shall know the name by which he is called; for he shall be called by the name of Christ. VerseEnd

Verse10 And now it shall come to pass that whosoever shall not take upon them the name of Christ must be called by some other name; therefore he findeth himself on the left hand of God. VerseEnd Verse11 And I would that 2PP ye should remember also that this is the name that I said I should give unto 2PP you that never should be blotted out, except it be through transgression; therefore, take heed that 2PP ye do not transgress, that the name be not blotted out of 2PP your hearts. VerseEnd Verse12 I say unto 2PP you, I would that 2PP ye should remember to retain the name written always in 2PP your hearts, that 2PP ye are not found on the left hand of God, but that 2PP ye hear and know the voice by which 2PP ye shall be called, and also the name by which he shall call 2PP you. VerseEnd Verse13 For how knoweth a man the master whom he has not served, and who is a stranger unto him, and is far from the thoughts and intents of his heart? VerseEnd Verse14 And again, doth a man take an ass which belongeth to his neighbor and keep him? I say unto 2PP you, nay. He will not even suffer that he shall feed among his flocks, but will drive him away and cast him out. I say unto 2PP you that even so shall it be among 2PP you if 2PP ye know not the name by which 2PP ye are called. VerseEnd Verse15 Therefore I would that 2PP ye should be steadfast and immovable, always abounding in good works, that Christ, the Lord God Omnipotent, may seal 2PP you his, that 2PP you may be brought to Heaven, that 2PP ye may have everlasting salvation and eternal life through the wisdom, and power, and justice, and mercy of him who created all things in Heaven and in earth, who is God above all.
